methodology_other: Data were collected from the Annuaire Statistique De La Republique Centrafricaine Année 2016, the Annuaire Statistique De La Republique Centrafricaine Année 2017, the Troisième Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitation (RGPH03), and the RGPH-4: Principaux Resultats De La Cartographie 2021, all from the Institut Centrafricain des Statistiques et des Etudes Economiques et Sociales (ICASEES). Data were also collected from Central African Republic: Data on Forcibly Displaced Populations and Stateless Persons, from OCHA-UNHCR.
name: car-subnational-boundaries-and-tabular-data
notes:
The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-, second-, and third-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided.

The tabular data contain total population for 2016 (estimates) and 2021 (estimates), as well as five-year age group and sex (2016 only), and information relating to ethnicity, religion, language, housing units, health, agriculture, displacement.
